title: Field Notch
rationale: A split folio turns the act of indexing a record into a recognizable silhouette.
visual_system: Two staggered green plates separated by a rising diagonal. Custom outlined VESKIL lettering. Warm paper with deep pine ink and rust accents.
tradeoffs: The oblique seam needs a minimum size. The single-ink silhouette retains the seam through transparent space.
differentiation: The brief excludes wildlife silhouettes, map pins and leaf motifs. This demo records design rationale only and has no market search.
provenance: Original demo geometry authored for this project. No external design inputs.
